versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **`/developer` pipeline for Claude Code.** One command takes a requirement through research, OpenSpec analysis, Figma
  design, parallel test-first development, review, UI autotests and a PR, with the owner's approval before any code and
  before any command that changes the car's state. Maestro smoke flows for the companion app and the head-unit app live
  in `e2e/`.

### Changed
- **Project documentation moved to [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec).** Current behaviour is in
  `openspec/specs/` (14 capabilities, checked against the code), and every unfinished feature, research lead, blocked
  path and dead end is a change in `openspec/changes/` (`openspec list` shows what's left). `docs/features/`,
  `docs/FID_RESEARCH.md`, `docs/UI_BRIEF.md` and the st-doc tree (`docs/INDEX.yaml`, `docs/areas/`) are gone; their
  content is in OpenSpec. README.md, this file and `docs/ADB_QUEUE.md` stay.
